symbols.name: Reset handler
symbols.detail: Reset vector target; disables IRQ handling and clears the decimal flag; entry point.

symbols.name: PPU control and stack init
symbols.detail: Writes PPU control and initializes the CPU stack.

symbols.name: Wait for vblank twice
symbols.detail: Polls PPUSTATUS twice, waiting for vblank transitions.

symbols.name: Choose reset path
symbols.detail: Inspects retained startup bytes and the $A5 marker before choosing the reset path.

symbols.name: Initialize mode byte
symbols.detail: Initializes the mode byte at $0770 (source address).

symbols.name: Write startup marker
symbols.detail: Writes the startup marker $A5 to $07FF (source address).

symbols.name: NMI handler
symbols.detail: NMI vector target where the original game performs its frame work; entry point.

symbols.name: Latch and read controllers
symbols.detail: Writes one, then zero, to $4016 and reads the controllers; entry point.

symbols.name: Serial controller read helper
symbols.detail: Reads eight serial values, shifts them into an accumulator and stores the result in $06FC,X; entry point.

symbols.name: Clear memory regions
symbols.detail: Clears the selected CPU-memory regions through a zero-page pointer; entry point.

symbols.name: Disable channels in mode zero
symbols.detail: Reads mode $0770; when zero, writes zero to $4015, disabling the channels.

symbols.name: Enable APU voices
symbols.detail: Writes $FF to $4017 (five-step sequencing, IRQ inhibited), then $0F to $4015 to enable the four synthesized voices.

symbols.name: Pulse 1 sweep/duty writes
symbols.detail: Writes Y to pulse 1 sweep ($F382) and X to its duty/envelope register ($F385).

symbols.name: Indexed timer writer
symbols.detail: Reads a timer pair through Y from $FF01/$FF00, then writes $4002,X and $4003,X; X selects the voice register block.

symbols.name: Pulse 2 duty/sweep writes
symbols.detail: Writes the pulse 2 duty/envelope ($F3A0) and sweep ($F3A3) registers.

symbols.name: Noise register writes
symbols.detail: Writes noise volume/envelope, noise period/mode and length/restart.

symbols.name: Note duration table read
symbols.detail: Reads the PAL note duration table at $FF66,Y (single instruction site).
